title: Cultam - Weapon Stats & Location (Expedition 33)
description: Cultam in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 - which character uses it, its element and scaling, and exactly where to get it.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Cultam is a dark-element weapon used by Gustave / Verso. It scales with Defense (A), Agility (B).

sections.title: How to Get the Cultam
sections.content:
Location: Monoco's Station - Grandis merchant.

Obtained from Monoco's Station - Grandis merchant.

sections.title: Is the Cultam Worth Using?
sections.content: Scales off Defense (A), Agility (B). A dedicated dark pick - it belongs in a build already committed to that element.
